trigger: Before a young child is mobile
steps: Install tamper-resistant outlet covers or sliding-plate covers on all accessible outlets.
Add cabinet/drawer latches to areas with cleaning supplies, medications, or sharp tools.
Anchor bookshelves, dressers, and TVs to the wall with anti-tip straps.
Install corner guards on sharp furniture edges at child height.
Walk the home at a toddler's eye level to spot missed hazards.
